mapper.select: SELECT seat_class_id as id, class_name, priority, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_seat_class ORDER BY priority ASC

SELECT DISTINCT sc.seat_class_id as id, sc.class_name, sc.priority, sc.created_at, sc.updated_at FROM tb_seat_class sc INNER JOIN tb_seat s ON sc.seat_class_id = s.seat_class_id WHERE s.venue_id = #{param1} ORDER BY sc.priority ASC
